script.speaker: brooke
script.text: last weekend of summer and this crew has never once eaten by the water. tonight we fix that!

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: also i beat liam paddleboarding this morning, so winner picks. GREEK. the whole boardwalk smells like lemon and charcoal

script.speaker: liam
script.text: i fell in twice and swallowed half the harbour. greek sounds perfect. i'm starving

script.speaker: mina
script.text: greek by the water sounds lovely :) liam, are you okay after all that swimming?

script.speaker: liam
script.text: my pride's a little soggy. the rest of me is just hungry

script.speaker: mina
script.text: okay, can i ask for something? could we go somewhere i can order a real main this time?

script.speaker: mina
script.text: i've had enough side salads and plates of fries for one summer

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: MINA. yes. you asking for something might be my favourite thing that's happened all summer

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: yes!! ooh, the harbour places do amazing grilled fish. would that work for you?

script.speaker: mina
script.text: not fish either, sorry :) a proper main where nothing on the plate ever had a face

script.speaker: liam
script.text: nothing with a face, and a whole main, not a pile of sides pretending to be dinner. got it

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: ok my turn. it's the last summer weekend, so i want somewhere loud. a packed room, people laughing over each other, plates flying past

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: a hushed little dining room tonight would feel like summer ended early

script.speaker: mina
script.text: a loud, happy table sounds perfect, brooke :)

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: and after a whole summer of night-market fryers, i want a light plate. the kind you finish feeling better than when you sat down

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: ok logistics: i'm taking the water taxi over and back. bobbing boat, ten minutes each way

script.speaker: roxy
script.text: which means my stomach can't be fighting yogurt dips or crumbly cheese on the ride home. none of that in mine

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: roxy plus a bobbing boat plus a repeat of the milkshake incident? absolutely not. zero dairy for you

script.speaker: liam
script.text: assistant, the boardwalk is long and i am running on harbour water. please
